name: Ambert Farm
tagline: Link to Ambert Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/AmbertFarm/
description: In 885 Steeplechase Dr., SC, Ambert Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a working pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
